Story wise I had a blast following her plot line, [Spoiler Alert] and her ending was truly heart wrenching I think by far the most tragic of them all. She became exactly who she wanted to be in the universe, and in the end she lost it all. She will forever live without the knowledge of what she did for the universe. [ /Spoilers]
